facts.text: The Great Lawn loop uses paved paths; the wider trail network includes pavement, mulch and crushed gravel. Just under four laps around the Great Lawn make a mile.
quote: Whether you’re looping around the Great Lawn on paved paths, exploring shaded woodland trails, or admiring the views near the prairie and pond, there’s a route for every pace and preference.
With a blend of pavement, mulch, and crushed gravel, the trails invite you to unwind and take in the fresh air across 130 acres of parkland.
It takes just under 4 laps around the Great Lawn to complete a mile!

facts.text: Mobility devices used for accessibility purposes are exempt from the park’s motorized-device prohibition. The rules also allow Class 1, 2 and 3 e-bikes in non-powered mode and low-speed micro-mobility scooters.
facts.quote: Motorized vehicles and motor-propelled devices are prohibited within Blue Ash parks, except: Mobility devices used for accessibility purposes Class 1,2,3 E-bikes in non-powered mode only Low-speed micro-mobility scooters

facts.text: Family restrooms are under the Observation Tower, beneath the Glass Canopy and near the Main Playground. From December 1 to January 31 the playground restrooms close and the Community Room restrooms open only during Ice Rink hours.
quote: Family restrooms are available in three convenient locations throughout Summit Park: – Under the Observation Tower – Beneath the Glass Canopy – Near the Main Playground

Winter Closures (Dec 1 – Jan 31): To protect plumbing during colder months, some restrooms and amenities will be closed: Playground restrooms will be closed for the season. Community Room restrooms will be open only during Ice Rink hours.

facts.text: The park describes the main playground as having ADA ramps; it does not give ramp dimensions or a continuous route description.
facts.quote: With inclusion, accessibility, and innovation top of mind, it features ADA ramps.

facts.text: The tower page, updated October 26, 2026, reports a closure starting October 2 for approximately six to eight weeks to replace damaged glass panels. Reopening updates are to appear in the homepage alert; the estimate is not a confirmed reopening date.
quote: Starting Oct. 2, the Summit Park Tower is temporarily closed for approximately six to eight weeks while damaged glass panels are replaced.
Reopening updates will be posted via the alert on the Summit Park homepage.
(Page updated: 10.26.26)

facts.text: The restroom page says the Canopy restrooms stay open year-round. It does not describe door controls, toilet transfers or adult-changing equipment.
facts.quote: Canopy restrooms will remain open year-round

facts.text: Outdoor water fountains are turned off for winter and reopen in spring, according to the park’s restroom notice. Bring drinking water during the winter shutdown.
facts.quote: All outdoor water fountains throughout the City will also be turned off for the winter and reopen in the spring.

facts.text: The main playground is southwest of the Canopy. Its published features include seating with sightlines for parents, passive and active play areas and nearby restrooms.
quote: Located southwest of the Canopy, this award-winning, colorful, one-acre playground features traversable ropes, play mounds, and extra-wide slides.
Other features include an activity wall, ample seating with visibility for parents, passive and active play areas, and restrooms conveniently located just a few steps away.

facts.text: General park hours are dawn to midnight, but natural spaces, trails, ponds and other unlit areas close at 11 p.m.
facts.quote: Hours Dawn to Midnight Natural spaces, trails, ponds, and other unlit areas of the park close at 11:00 p.m.

facts.text: The October 21, 2026 alert reports the Water Corridor closed for maintenance. It gives no reopening date.
quote: Water Corridor Temporary Closure The Water Corridor is temporarily closed for maintenance.

facts.text: For the 2026–27 rink season, sensory-sensitive sessions are listed for December 13 and December 21, 2026, from 11 a.m. to noon. Places are limited and reservations are required. The park describes a calmer, less crowded skate and a quiet sensory item to choose at check-in.
quote: November 14, 2026 – January 10, 2027

Sensory Sensitive Hours (Limited Spots, Reservation Required) Sunday, December 13 | 11 AM to 12 PM Monday, December 21 | 11 AM to 12 PM Enjoy a calmer, less crowded skate designed for guests who prefer or benefit from a quieter experience. Each skater can choose a quiet sensory item at check in. Space is limited, so reserve your spot today:

facts.text: The 2026–27 rink page offers free skate helpers on a first-come, first-served basis. It does not describe wheelchair use on the ice, assisted transfers or staff-provided physical support.
quote: November 14, 2026 – January 10, 2027
Free skate helpers, sponsored by MadTree Parks and Rec , are available on a first-come, first-served basis to help new or young skaters find their balance and confidence on the ice.

facts.text: The rink’s advertised season is November 14, 2026–January 10, 2027. Regular tickets are sold at the rink, with no online or advance sales; weather can temporarily close it, with updates on the park homepage.
quote: November 14, 2026 – January 10, 2027
Tickets are available for purchase at the rink only (no online or advance sales).
Weather and temperature changes may temporarily close the rink. A pop-up alert will appear on the Summit Park homepage in the event of a closure.

facts.text: The venue says it is ADA-compliant, including its entry and bathrooms.
facts.quote: The Woodward Theater is ADA-compliant, including ADA-compliant entry and bathrooms.

facts.text: Woodward lists two metered accessible spaces on Main Street within 50 feet of its main entrance. Its visitor page describes Ziegler Park Garage, one block east at Sycamore and 14th, as covered, open 24 hours and containing 500 spaces.
quote: There are two metered handicap parking spaces on Main St within 50 feet of our main entrance.
Ziegler Park Garage , located one-block east of the Woodward at the corner of Sycamore and 14th streets, is a covered, 24-hour facility with 500 spaces.

facts.text: Seating is not always available, but a limited-capacity seating area for people with special needs is offered on request.
facts.quote: Seating is not always available, though we do offer a limited capacity seating area designated for those with special needs, upon request.

facts.text: By streetcar, get off at Hanke Exchange (12th & Main) and walk two blocks north on Main; a Metro stop is one block north at Main and Orchard.
quote: Take the streetcar to the Hanke Exchange Station (12th & Main) and walk two blocks north on Main.
The Woodward Theater is located one-block south of a Metro stop at the corner Main and Orchard streets.

facts.text: Bags must be clear and no larger than 12 × 12 × 6 inches; clutches may be no larger than 1 × 6 × 4 inches. Diaper bags are an exception when accompanied by a child and are subject to a full entry search. The page does not specify a medical-bag exception; confirm that need before arriving.
facts.quote: Purses / Backpacks / Bags are prohibited unless they fit the guidelines below: Bags must be CLEAR and may not exceed 12"x12"x6" Clutches are permitted but may not exceed 1"x6"x4" Exceptions: Diaper Bags w/ accompanying child. These bags are subject to full search upon entry.

facts.text: The theater opens for scheduled events rather than maintaining general visitor hours. Check the individual show listing; admission for guests under 18 depends on the event.
quote: The Woodward Theater is open when we have events: concerts, films, theater, fundraisers, ticketed events, and anything else open to the public.
I'm under 18. Can I go to a concert at the Woodward? A: It depends on the particular show.

facts.text: Ziegler Park’s own parking page describes a 400-space, two-level garage, with elevators in the northwest and southwest corners. This describes the nearby garage, not a verified continuous route to the theater.
quote: Ziegler Park's 400-space, two-level, underground parking garage is located directly below the great lawn.
The garage's wide, open parking decks are well-lit and have have three broad stairwells, in addition to elevators that are located at the northwest and southwest corners.

facts.text: The Ziegler garage’s vehicle entrance and exit are on Sycamore Street, at the published address 1322 Sycamore Street. Automated pay stations allow payment before returning to the vehicle; the operator says the garage is staffed around the clock.
quote: The vehicular entrance/exit is located on Sycamore Street. Automated pay stations allow you to pay for parking before returning to your vehicle.
ADDRESS 1322 Sycamore Street Cincinnati, OH 45202
The garage, which is available to monthly and daily parkers, is open and staffed 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

facts.text: Accessible parking is available with a disability placard: hang it on the mirror and attendants direct you to the right lot. Shuttles run from public lots to the gates, and a patron drop-off is by the North Entrance.
facts.quote: Accessible parking is available to those with a disability placard. Place the placard on your rear view mirror and parking attendants will direct you to the appropriate lot. Shuttles are available from public parking lots to gate entrances. To drop someone off at the entry gates, drive to the patron drop-off located by the North Entrance.

facts.text: Elevators serve the upper levels of Grandstand and Center Court; ushers can direct you to the closest one. Request ADA seating when ordering. If tickets are already purchased, call 513-651-0303 or ask at the North Entrance ticket office during the tournament. The organizer says it will do its best to accommodate the request, rather than guaranteeing a seat change.
quote: There is elevator access to the upper levels of Grandstand and Center Court. An usher will be able to direct you to the elevator closest to your seats.

If you are in need of ADA seating, please let us know when you are placing your ticket order and we will do our best to accommodate the request. If you have already purchased tickets and are now in need of ADA seating, please call 513-651-0303 or see the ticket office at the North Entrance during the tournament and we will do our best to accommodate your party.

facts.text: The venue does not rent wheelchairs, scooters or walkers and has no wheelchair concierge service to help guests around the grounds, so bring your own mobility aid.
quote: The Lindner Family Tennis Center does not have wheelchairs, scooters, or walkers available for rent.
The Lindner Family Tennis Center does not have a wheelchair concierge service to physically assist guests around the grounds.

facts.text: Outside food is not allowed except in a limited quantity for medical or infant purposes. Re-entry is allowed if you exit-scan on the way out.
quote: Food, except in a limited quantity for medical or infant purposes
Re-entry will be permitted after exit scanning on your way out of the grounds.

facts.text: The tournament’s interactive map describes limited wheelchair parking directly outside the North Entrance. This does not establish shuttle boarding arrangements or guarantee an available space.
facts.quote: Limited wheelchair parking is available directly outside the North Entrance.

facts.text: Rideshare pickup and drop-off are at the East Entrance. This is separate from the patron drop-off described by the North Entrance.
quote: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up is located at the East Entrance.
To drop someone off at the entry gates, drive to the patron drop-off located by the North Entrance.

facts.text: During the tournament, the First Aid center is at the south end of Stadium 3 and north end of the Commons.
facts.quote: If you are in need of first aid, head to the First Aid center located on the south end of Stadium 3 and north end of the Commons.

facts.text: The map directs visitors needing nursing or rehydration help to the Mercy Health First Aid Center. It does not describe a separate nursing room or its facilities.
facts.quote: Visit the Mercy Health First Aid Center for all your on-site health needs. Whether you need a band aid or more serious medical attention, you're nursing or need to rehydrate, the team from Mercy Health is here to help.

facts.text: The interactive map identifies misting stations and drinking-water stations for tournament visitors. These descriptions do not establish an indoor cooling room.
quote: Stay cool with one of our misting stations.
Stay hydrated with one of our water stations.

facts.text: Metal detectors are posted at all entrances. The FAQ says guests are asked to empty their pockets and pass through the detector; it does not explain an alternative screening procedure for medical devices or mobility aids.
facts.quote: Metal detectors will be stationed at all entrances around the grounds. All guests will be asked to empty their pockets and pass through the detector.

facts.text: Prohibited items found during bag inspection must be returned to the owner’s vehicle or discarded. The tournament says it provides no storage area for them; bags left at a gate remain the owner’s risk.
facts.quote: Prohibited items that are discovered during inspections must either be returned to their owner’s vehicle or discarded. The Lindner Family Tennis Center will not provide a storage area for these items. Any bag left at a gate is left at the owner’s risk.

facts.text: The detailed water-bottle allowance is one unopened see-through plastic bottle up to 1 liter, or one empty non-see-through water container up to 1 liter. Labels for brands other than the tournament sponsor must be removed before entry.
quote: One unopened see-through plastic bottle of water up to 33.5 ounces/1 liter. If not see-through, one empty water container up to 33.5 ounces/1 liter.
Due to sponsorship exclusivity, if your water bottle has a label other than the tournament sponsor brand, the label must be removed before entering tournament grounds.

facts.text: The prohibited-items list exempts motorized vehicles associated with a medical need and exempts service animals from its animal restriction. It does not specify device dimensions or assistance with transfers.
quote: Hoverboards, Skateboards, Segways or any motorized vehicle not associated with a medical need
Animals (Except service animals)

facts.text: Single-compartment bags such as totes or cinch bags must be at most 12 × 18 × 15 inches and fit on the visitor’s lap or under their seat. Single-strap diaper bags are allowed with a child. Multi-compartment backpacks with multiple shoulder straps are prohibited, and all bags are searched.
quote: Guests will not be permitted to bring backpacks (multi-compartment bag with multiple shoulder straps) into Lindner Family Tennis Center
All bags are subject to a complete and thorough search.
Tote bags, cinch bags and other single compartment bags 12″ x 18″ x 15″ or smaller (bag must fit on lap or under the seat occupied). Single strap diaper bags if accompanied by a child.

facts.text: Newport’s branch page lists curbside pickup and home delivery among its store services. The branch phone is 859-360-2022.
quote: STORE SERVICES Blade Sharpening Carpet Cleaning Curbside Pickup Glass Cutting Home & Auto Keys & FOB Duplication Home Delivery
Newport 82 Carothers Rd Newport, KY 41071 (859) 360-2022

facts.text: For curbside pickup, select free store pickup when ordering online and wait for the email confirming the order is ready before traveling. Newport is included in the service’s location list.
quote: ORDER - Order on acehardare.com and select FREE STORE PICKUP during checkout. DRIVE - Await email confirmation that your order is ready for pickup and drive to our local Great Lakes Ace.
KENTUCKY Florence Hebron Newport Nicholasville

facts.text: On arrival for curbside pickup, call the store number in the confirmation email; the instructions say an associate will bring the order to you. They do not identify a collection bay or specify trunk loading.
quote: CALL - Once you arrive, call the store phone number (found on your confirmation email) and a helpful associate will bring your order to you.
KENTUCKY Florence Hebron Newport Nicholasville

facts.text: The home-delivery page includes Newport and says the product page indicates whether delivery or assembly is available from the selected store. It describes store-to-door delivery by an associate; no inside-the-home carrying service is established.
quote: The product page will indicate if delivery or assembly are available from your store
DELIVER FROM STORE TO DOOR - Your order will be delivered by a helpful Great Lakes Associate.
KENTUCKY Florence Hebron Newport Nicholasville
